summaryDeep: Their intensity and pull toward depth and control work smoothly with your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is that it can be easy to settle into comfort without fully engaging the deeper potential of the connection. If both people avoid vulnerability or keep important feelings unspoken, the relationship may remain supportive but never reach the level of closeness it is capable of creating.
advice: Allow trust to build naturally. Share your feelings a little more openly than you normally would. Pay attention to what this relationship teaches you about your needs, your patterns, and your capacity for intimacy. The real gift of this aspect is not intensity. It is the chance to create a deeper, more authentic connection while staying grounded in yourself.
